data.investment_objective: The primary objective of the Scheme is to generate long-term capital appreciation by predominantly investing in equity &equity related instruments and to enable eligible investors to avail deduction from total income, as permitted under theIncome Tax Act, 1961 as amended from time to time. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective shall berealized.
